hooks.name: i18n Parity Check
hooks.description: When wedding.ts is saved, verify every en key in the strings block has a matching hi key.

action.command: node -e "const i=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const d=JSON.parse(i);const f=d.file||'';if(!f||!f.includes('wedding.ts'))process.exit(0);let src;try{src=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');}catch(e){process.exit(0);}const enStr=src.match(/strings[\s\S]*?en\s*:\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);const hiStr=src.match(/strings[\s\S]*?hi\s*:\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);if(!enStr||!hiStr){console.log('i18n-parity: could not parse strings block, skipping.');process.exit(0);}const getKeys=block=>[...block.matchAll(/(\w+)\s*:/g)].map(m=>m[1]);const ek=getKeys(enStr[1]);const hk=getKeys(hiStr[1]);const missing=ek.filter(k=>!hk.includes(k));if(missing.length){console.error('I18N-PARITY: en keys missing hi equivalent: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}else{console.log('i18n-parity: all '+ek.length+' en keys have hi equivalents.');}"
